verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a Payments API for single, scheduled, periodic, bulk and variable recurring bank-to-bank payments. It also offers a Hosted/Connect option that handles SCA and bank redirects, plus webhooks for tracking payment status. Geography is only implied by the rails it names (Faster Payments in the UK, SEPA in Europe) rather than stated as explicit live coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit per-country list of live payment geographies and institution coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of payment initiation working in production.
